30 min – 2 hours (depends a lot on luck)

{npc:Captain Haba}, in Svargrond, is hunting a sea serpent in the northern seas. Bring him fish to make bait, set out with him to the open sea and use the telescope to tell him where the creature is. When you find it, you get access to the underwater caves with {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents}.
There are rumours of Sea Serpents roaming the northern seas and attacking ships.
{item:Helmet of the Deep} to explore underwater at the end.
50 gp each, bought from Captain Haba on the high seas; you may need many more (up to 220)
Access to the {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents} spawns (Sea Serpent Area)
Sea Serpent Area (underwater caves of the Sea Serpents)
When you find the serpent with the telescope and ask {npc:Captain Haba} for {key:caves}.
You need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} to go down underwater.
Bring plenty of money for the {item:Bait|baits}: each costs 50 gp and the number needed depends on luck (10 is the minimum, it can reach 220).
Always read the most recent message in the **Server Log**: the on-screen message may be out of date after you click the telescope several times.
The sooner you tell the captain the position, the better: consecutive "huge shadow" messages increase the chance of finishing.

Take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat; {npc:Captain Haba}'s ship is the one right to the **south** of it.
In **Svargrond**, find {npc:Captain Haba} on the first floor of the ship south of the boat that carries people between cities. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.

Hand over the fish in the order requested, saying {key:bait} each time: 5 {item:Fish}, then 5 {item:Northern Pike|Northern Pikes}, then 5 {item:Green Perch|Green Perches} and finally 5 {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts}.
Head out to the high seas
Say {key:hunt} and {key:yes}. The captain takes you out to the high seas (the ship is different, but the captain is the same).

On the ship on the high seas, tell Captain Haba {key:hi} and {key:trade} and buy at least 10 {item:Bait|Baits} (50 gp each). If you want to hear the instructions, say {key:instructions}. To return to Svargrond, say {key:Svargrond}.
Use the bait on the crane
Go to the **left** side of the boat and use a {item:Bait} on the {item:Crane|crane}.
The crane on the left side of the boat
Go down to floor -1 of the boat and step into the teleport. It takes you to the top of the mast, where there is a {item:Telescope}.
The teleport on floor -1 of the boat
Use the telescope. After the first message, use it again. Read the second message (in the Server Log) to find out where the serpent is.

Go back to {npc:Captain Haba} and say the right word according to the message (see the table). Then use a new bait on the crane, climb the mast and use the telescope again. Repeat until the final message appears.
Do not go to the captain: use the telescope again.
You gave the wrong position. Next time you will see the message "water as far as the eye can reach".
You are done! You can go underwater.
The "small dot" means the serpent is far away; the "huge shadow" means it is very close. You can receive dots/shadows again even after huge shadows: it mostly depends on luck.
When you find the spot, tell {npc:Captain Haba} {key:hi} and {key:caves}.
Go down with the Helmet of the Deep

Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} and step into the teleport to go underwater. There you meet {creature:Deepsea Blood Crab|Deepsea Blood Crabs} and {creature:Young Sea Serpent|Young Sea Serpents}. Underwater you can take the helmet off, but without full drown protection you take damage: keep it on.
Do not enter without the Helmet of the Deep on.
To find the {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents} you have to go down using {spell:Levitate} or parcels. {item:Pot|Pots} and {item:Ice Cube|Ice Cubes} work better, because monsters cannot push them.
Access to the Sea Serpent spawns

To return, go up with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/pots/ice cubes) at the places where you went down and head back to the point where you arrived underwater; the sources do not describe another exit. Back on the boat on the high seas, tell {npc:Captain Haba} {key:hi} and {key:svargrond} to return to the port of Svargrond. From there, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin, Thais or Venore.
The quest shows up in the Quest Log under *Tibia Tales*.
